results.question: what is expedition 33
results.reply_text:
Expedition 33 is a 2025 role‑playing video game developed by Sandfall Interactive and published by Kepler Interactive. Set in a dark‑fantasy Belle Époque world, the story follows the members of Expedition 33—led by characters such as Gustave and Maelle—as they embark on a desperate quest to destroy the Paintress, a being that erases everyone who reaches a certain age each year (the “Gommage”).
Key details from the verified sources:

Genre: Single‑player turn‑based RPG with real‑time parry and dodge mechanics.
Engine: Built on Unreal Engine 5.
Release date: 24 April 2025.
Developer & Publisher: Sandfall Interactive / Kepler Interactive.
Core premise: The expedition races against time (only one year left to live) to break the Paintress’s cycle of death and uncover the fate of previous expeditions.

In short, Expedition 33 is a modern, visually rich RPG that blends tactical combat with a poignant, time‑limited narrative set in a stylized historical French setting.

According to the latest verified sources (interviews with the game’s director Guillaume Broche and announcements from Sandfall Interactive), the franchise is expanding beyond the original title:



Announcement
Details

Broche clarified that “Clair Obscur” is the franchise name and Expedition 33 is one story within it. He stated that a new title (still under the “Clair Obscur” banner) is in development, aiming for a similar scale to the debut game.


Edge magazine (Issue 419, 2025)
Broche mentioned that the next release will be “Clair Obscur: [New Title]”, promising a similarly large production and a fresh narrative while retaining the core mechanics (turn‑based combat with real‑time parry/dodge).

Re‑iterated the franchise approach: “Clair Obscur” will continue with multiple stories, with Expedition 33 being the first chapter.



What to Expect:

Sequel: A full‑blown follow‑up titled “Clair Obscur: [New Title]” (exact title TBD) that will likely explore a different era or region within the same universe, maintaining the turn‑based + real‑time combat hybrid.

Timeline: Development is ongoing; no official release date has been announced yet, but Sandfall Interactive expects the sequel to launch within the next 12–18 months after the original’s release.

Bottom line: Yes—Expedition 33 is part of a broader “Clair Obscur” franchise, and Sandfall Interactive has confirmed both a sequel and an expansion are in the works.
